after:
- name: Require a dated changelog section for the tag
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
        run: node scripts/release-notes.mjs "$RELEASE_TAG" --out "$RUNNER_TEMP/release-notes.md"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
before:
- name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
